ANKIT AGARWAL SENIOR PROJECT & PRODUCT MANAGER | BFSI, CORE BANKING, PAYMENTS & DIGITAL TRANSFORMATION

Pune, India | +91- 9654363850| mail2ankit1986@gmail.com |

PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY

Results-driven Senior Project & Product Manager with 12+ years of experience steering end-to-end digital banking, core payment platforms, and fintech transformation initiatives across the complete SDLC. Proven track record leading multi-disciplinary cross- functional squads (15+ members spanning engineering, product, QA, risk, operations, and compliance) to deliver high-velocity, regulatory-compliant solutions across UPI, ACH, SWIFT, and Cross-Border payments. Expert in translating complex business/regulatory needs into actionable roadmaps (Aha!, Jira), shaping target operating models (TOM), and managing RAID registers. SME in operationalizing KYC/AML (CDD/EDD), PEP & Sanctions Screening, Behavioral Fraud Analytics, and Commercial Lending workflows for top-tier MNCs, Unicorns, and high-growth BFSI platforms.

5% – 8% Faster Delivery AGILE SPEED & SPRINT GOVERNANCE

8% – 10% Defect Reduction SHIFT-LEFT QA & HYPERCARE

100% / Zero Breach AML / KYC / BSA REGULATORY RECORD

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE

Senior Project & Product Manager – Banking & Payments | Rugr Fintech Pvt. Ltd.

Sep 2025 – Present | Mumbai, India (Hybrid)

Direct end-to-end project and product delivery for core banking and multi-rail payment platforms (UPI, ACH, SWIFT, Cross-Border

Payments), steering scope, budget, RAID risk registers, and quality gates across 15+ member cross-functional squads.

Define product vision, strategic roadmaps (Aha!), and prioritize backlogs across 6 parallel transformation workstreams: Client

Onboarding, KYC/AML Sanction Screening, Behavioral Fraud Monitoring, Credit Operations, and Chargeback Analysis.

Translate 100+ complex regulatory and market requirements into detailed epics, user stories, process flows, and acceptance criteria

in Jira, accelerating program delivery timelines firm-wide by 5–8%.

Negotiate key vendor contracts and third-party API integration SLAs, optimizing operational margins while upholding stringent

platform security, data integrity, and compliance guidelines.

Establish Target Operating Model (TOM) frameworks and cross-functional governance across technology, legal, compliance, and

operations to streamline cross-border payment initiation and settlement.

Project / Program & Product Manager | TRST Health Pvt. Ltd.

Mar 2024 – Apr 2025 | Pune, India (Remote)

Spearheaded release management and Agile governance across multi-pod engineering teams, managing full release lifecycles

including production readiness, deployment governance, defect triage, and post-production hypercare.

Slashed production defect rates by 8–10% by overhauling QA governance, introducing mandatory pre-release readiness reviews,

and embedding automated quality gates in sprint planning.

Managed cross-pod dependencies, critical path risk mitigations, and Jira backlog health, significantly enhancing delivery

predictability and feature deployment lead times.

Mentored PM, QA, BA, and operations leads, reducing senior executive escalations by ~30% through executive status reporting,

Power BI MIS dashboards, and clear risk escalation protocols.

Senior QA & Project Lead – Enterprise Banking | Synechron Digital Pvt. Ltd.

Aug 2021 – Feb 2024 | Pune, India

Led end-to-end test planning, UAT execution, and delivery coordination across enterprise global banking and cross-border payment

transformation programs.

Compressed dev cycle times by 5–7% by shifting QA left into sprint planning and backlog grooming, catching requirement gaps

upstream prior to code build.

Served as primary liaison between business stakeholders, development pods, and global delivery leads to ensure seamless ISO

20022 message flows, payment gateway integrations, and production deployments.

Contributed core delivery governance frameworks and quality assurance best practices to Synechron's Global Payments Practice.

Sr. Risk & Project Manager – Digital Lending | Commercial Capital Funding LLC

Aug 2020 – Mar 2022 | Remote (US)

Served as primary escalation point for KYC (CDD/EDD), BSA, and AML operations across commercial lending portfolios,

maintaining zero compliance incidents throughout tenure.

Directed incident response lifecycles (detection, containment, root-cause investigation, recovery, post-mortems) for critical

operational events, substantially reducing Mean Time to Resolution (MTTR).

Designed phased project roadmaps for major commercial lending servicing platforms under strict US regulatory frameworks (BSA,

USA PATRIOT Act, FACTA).

Modernized underwriting and credit risk decisioning workflows, collaborating with risk, legal, and engineering teams to enhance

decisioning speed and accuracy.

Risk & Project Manager | Qihoo Finance India Pvt. Ltd.

Sep 2019 – Aug 2020 | Gurgaon, India

Managed daily operations across KYC, AML, PEP & Sanctions Screening, and Transaction Filtering teams for a high-volume digital

consumer lending platform.

Operationalized Behavioral Analytics for Fraud Detection and anomaly detection rules, driving down fraud rates and unauthorized

transactions.

• Streamlined Chargeback Analysis and Dispute Resolution workflows with partner banks, lowering dispute turnaround times and

financial losses.

Senior Business & Project Analyst / Lead Credit Analyst | Biz2Credit & American Express

Jan 2013 – Jun 2019 | NCR, India

Biz2Credit (2019): Spearheaded KYC Records Refresher programs, AML transaction monitoring, and customer onboarding

verification, ensuring 100% regulatory compliance.

American Express (2013–2019): Managed card underwriting, credit decisioning, and dispute management across US, ANZ, and India portfolios for 6+ years; gained deep SME mastery in card issuing/acquiring, ISO 8583 standards, clearing & settlement, and regulatory reporting.

CORE COMPETENCIES & SPECIALIZED SKILLSETS

Project & Delivery:

Agile (Scrum/Kanban), Waterfall, Hybrid SDLC, Program Roadmapping, Backlog Refinement, Sprint Governance, RAID Management, Dependency Mapping, Release & Hypercare Planning, Target Operating Model (TOM).

Product Management:

Product Strategy & Vision, Market Opportunity Assessment, PRD/User Story Authoring, Go-To-Market (GTM) Strategy, User Acceptance Testing (UAT), Feature Prioritization, Competitor Research.

Payments & Core Banking:

UPI, ACH, SWIFT, Cross-Border Payments, Payment Gateways, Core Banking Transformation, ISO 8583, ISO 20022, Card Issuing & Acquiring, Clearing & Settlement, Reconciliation, API Banking.

RegTech, Risk & Compliance: AML, KYC (CDD/EDD), BSA, PEP & Sanctions Screening, Behavioral Analytics Fraud Monitoring, Chargeback & Dispute Resolution, Commercial Credit Underwriting, Client Onboarding, PCI-DSS.

Tools & Technologies:

Jira, Confluence, MS Project, Smartsheet, Aha! Roadmapping, Power BI (Dashboards/MIS), SQL, Postman (API Testing), Figma, HP ALM, Sauce Labs.

EDUCATION & PROFESSIONAL CERTIFICATIONS

Bachelor of Engineering (B.E.) in Computer Science RGPV University, Bhopal | GPA: 7.8/10.0

Certifications & Badges: Certified Scrum Master (CSM), Product Management, Project Management, Power BI Data Analyst, Jira Administration, Procurement & Vendor Management.

PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY
Results-driven Senior Project & Product Manager with 12+ years of experience steering end-to-end digital banking, core payment platforms, and fintech transformation initiatives across the complete SDLC. Proven track record leading multi-disciplinary cross- functional squads (15+ members spanning engineering, product, QA, risk, operations, and compliance) to deliver high-velocity, regulatory-compliant solutions across UPI, ACH, SWIFT, and Cross-Border payments. Expert in translating complex business/regulatory needs into actionable roadmaps (Aha!, Jira), shaping target operating models (TOM), and managing RAID registers.
